Pixel Perfect Design System v1.0.0

- Initial release with bilingual (Chinese/English) professional-grade design system for Vibe coding applications.
- Includes 58 top product design templates and 9 comprehensive design specification sections, fully AI-readable via Markdown.
- Offers quick-start usage—no Figma or JSON schemas required, ready out of the box.
- Provides scripts for generating design docs from templates, websites, or custom configs.
- Features complete documentation and 5 full professional example templates (e.g., Xiaohongshu, Feishu, Linear, Stripe, Weibo).
